`page:accordion` has the same shape as `page:tabs`: `properties.items[]` entries are `{ …, children }` records, not component nodes (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, about `:2667`–`:2727`). So `forEachPageComponent` does not visit an accordion item's `children` either. This card's "The work" already asks for every declared prop shape that carries components through an item record. Accordion is a second, confirmed one. Its pins should cover both.

When the walk is fixed, re-true the sentences that name the exclusion: #24190's (PR #24347) name `page:tabs` only, and the master-detail siblings on `main` still say "wherever a page carries it".
